title: Community support for inclusive US education | Science
content: The Trump administration is working to dismantle inclusive education efforts by opposing diversity, equity, and inclusion (1); encouraging divisive actions in K-12 schools such as banning books (2) and excluding transgender children from sports (3); and terminating more than US$1 billion of government-funded awards granted to training programs, professional development, and research to advance inclusive STEM education (4, 5). As science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) educators and researchers, we call on the administration to reverse these harmful policies. In the meantime, we urge the STEM education community and institutions to continue their efforts to make education at all levels more inclusive and equitable.
